selection: Complete ZL .18-.23 is the local first argument. Chosen during exploratory work for actual repeated aiin applications, not because W depicts west. No other image/block assignment. Full473 target and all22 source duties retained.
scope_order: Only the local .18-.23 order is here owned. Cross-block page reading order is not established and is not used to certify earlier/later global reference availability. Whole continuation must declare and pay an explicit page-order assumption before parsing outside this local unit; it cannot change any register or value. This is an acknowledged remaining input, not a claim that all global references are in scope.

types.nonidentity: Wind and land are separate typed roles. No identity or disequality is asserted between traversed land and local place. No physical episode is introduced by a WindKind generic assertion.
types.binder_policy: Explicit allocation/replacement only at okees, ckhed[a:y], qose?y; never at a line/paragraph boundary. Reference terminals do not introduce or repair owners.

okees.definition: Introduce a fresh WindKind w from the written name/origin pair; write wind register W and holder register H_w. Reintroduction by this same explicit token replaces W/H_w for subsequent references, without changing earlier statements.

olaiin.definition: West designation with ordinal third. Two independently chosen semantic payloads.

qokal.definition: Infix typed product; no semantic argument omitted.

chdy.definition: Direction where the supplied sun sets.

qokshedy.definition: Read W. Undefined without an earlier explicit wind introduction.

qodain.definition: Postfix relation: the resolved wind has two companions. HAS, TWO, COMPANION are three paid payloads; no left/right or inheritance claim.

chckhy.definition: Assert the written qualities of the supplied wind under natural respect. Natural qualification and property assertion are two payloads.

ykeedy.definition: Same read-W meaning as qokshedy; paid lexical alias.

chedy.definition: The pair of cold and moist qualities. Both explicitly paid; no numeric thermal scale.

or.definition: Pure assertion marker retaining its argument and witness identity. It does NOT commit an inner unqualified property before outer modifiers have applied. Only a completed top-level statement commits.

aiin.definition: Resolve the supplied holder and form Warm(holder), with Plain respect initially. Exactly the same predicate and application law for wind and land.

ckhed[a:y].definition: Written introduction of fresh LandRegion l; writes L and D_l and returns HolderRef(l). D_l is an initially empty descriptive record whose owner is l. Binder, Land sort, holder return, description allocation are four paid payloads.

ain.definition: Resolve wind and snapshot the written land description. Result retains both owners and each recorded property witness; proposition Traverse(w,l) and those properties.

shedy.definition: Read D_l, whose owner was explicitly introduced. Resolution snapshots its currently committed property witnesses; no inferred or default quality.

qokeody.definition: Factive because: assert antecedent, result, and Because(antecedent,result). Antecedent includes the explicitly carried land description. Check same wind/land pair in the two supplied arguments. Result is exactly the supplied property clause, never the following no-harm statement.

qoekedy.definition: Same traversal constructor as ain, with two written arguments instead of a written pair. This is a paid alias and a paid uncurried application license, not a second meaning of ain.

qodaiin.definition: Retain the written pair and property. Property subject must equal the resolved wind in that pair. Does not insert a conditional or make traversal cause anything; EXPLAINS supplies the stated connection.

los.definition: Same typed product as qokal with prefix order. A second paid whole binding and position license.

ar.definition: Read W; paid alias. No organ, heat, case, pair or default-context meaning inherited.

qokshey.definition: Generalize the supplied local property over relevant presentations of this WindKind at the supplied local place. No claim of continuous wind presence, observed completed event, measured temperature or permanent change of nature.

qose?y.definition: Explicit deictic introduction of local human group u and its place p, writes U/P, records At(u,p), qualifies supplied property as Local(p). Group, place, locative relation, qualifier and reference writes are five paid payloads. This is a source-inspired deictic assumption, not image metadata.

og.definition: Read H_w; same underlying introduced wind via holder interface. Not an unmarked EntityRef-to-HolderRef coercion.

ol.definition: Explicit dereference, same function on WindKind and HumanGroup.

chol.definition: Infix negative HARM relation, two paid payloads. Not positive BENEFIT and not a causal result of warmth.

sheoly.definition: Read U written by HERE_AMONG_US; undefined before that explicit introduction.

grammar.semantics: Statement is Declaration or Assertable; Assertable is Proposition, PropertyClause or TraversalClause, each with its explicit proposition projection. Statements are contiguous complete typed expressions. Completion closes a statement; no token is skipped or converted to punctuation. A line end is not a boundary.
NameOriginSpec must be Pair[NameDesignation,Direction]. IntroduceWind asserts WindKind(w), designated name/ordinal and FromDirection(w,d). It writes W/H_w only after consuming both written fields.
DirectionOfSetting(suppliedSun).
Typed product, with its two contiguous operands. It binds before the enclosing constructor consumes its expected Pair argument.
Postfix HasTwoCompanions of that exact reference.
NaturalRespect(qualities,resolvedOwner); no unqualified warmth/cold slot and no inheritance to companions.

X must be Assertable (Proposition, PropertyClause or TraversalClause). Typed assertion marking preserves that sort. Pure while nested; top-level completed assertion commits the explicit proposition projection of X. Nested or remains redundant marking of the same proposition and does not create a new referent.
Warm(ResolveHolder(r)) creates a PropertyClause with explicit subject and Plain respect. Resolving HolderRef is part of this one declared interface, not a cast from any other type.
Evaluate a written Land introduction and return its HolderRef. Its effect is explicit and only occurs where this literal token is present.
Create TraverseWithDescription(w,l,D); D is a snapshot of explicit property witnesses of l.
Check identical owner pair, then form A AND R AND Because(A,R). Because does not include a subsequent top-level proposition. No extrapolation to other routes.
The same TraverseWithDescription as G10, through an explicitly paid two-argument interface.
Check PropertyClause.subject == pair.wind; retain both pair owners and the supplied property, without adding an event or time.
Prefix typed product; a second paid surface license for G04 product.

For all relevant presentations of this supplied wind kind at the supplied place, its supplied property holds there. The source permits this prospective generic interpretation, not empirical verification.
Allocate explicit deictic U/P and qualify the supplied property Local(P). Bindings persist into following statements until another explicit HERE_AMONG_US. No unspoken us/here owner.
Resolve the written reference to its value. Undefined references stay failures, never inferred from source or layout.
Negative HARM of the two explicitly resolved operands.

W/H_w, L/D_l and U/P are separate registers with the binder effects above. Each read captures the current value; later introductions do not rewrite earlier clauses. All references fail if their corresponding register is absent.

Commit the proposition projection of a completed top-level Assertable only after all written enclosing modifiers. For a PropertyClause, if its subject owns an explicitly introduced description register, append that exact qualified property witness idempotently. Description snapshots contain only these previously committed properties. No inverse of a predicate, inferred property or automatic co-reference is licensed.

grammar.surface: Generic qualification and causal witness identity
grammar.semantics: Natural, Plain and Local properties retain their qualifier fields. Warm of land and Warm of wind use one predicate but different holders. Clause/witness identities are immutable; passing a description carries the same recorded assertion, not a new material or episode.

Prefix constructors consume exactly their declared contiguous argument expressions. G04 and G18 are the only infix productions, G05 the only postfix production. No unrestricted unknown higher-order operator may swallow malformed first-contract strings. Additional ordinary terminals may later inhabit these sorts/signatures, but may not introduce new state effects, casts or production rules.

manual_clauses.reading: Let w be the third, west wind, from the direction of sunset.
It is cold and moist by nature.
Introduce land l and explicitly state its warmth; commit this property as witness WL in D_l.
The wind traverses that explicitly warm land. The traversal contains l and the same WL assertion.
Its traversal of that warm land explains that the same wind is always warm here among us. Only the qualified local warmth is the result.
That wind does not harm the explicitly introduced local human group. This is a separate statement.

costs.paid_choices: Every lexicon entry is hypothetical. Register allocation, reference snapshots, asserted-description attachment, generic qualification, factive because, two product orders and two traversal interfaces are additional grammar choices. Counts are descriptive, not a fit score. No free branch selects source owner or target reader.

rivals: Ordinary distinct natural/local quality predicates plus a separately written causal relation can express this same source; source cannot privilege this record implementation.
A single unqualified warmth/cold record loses a source distinction, but is not logically contradicted merely by qualities coexisting without an independently paid exclusivity axiom.
Merely listing traversal and warmth without explicit Because misses W06.
Treating no-harm as the causal result changes the source complement.
Land warmth may be expressed by a separately paid warm-land adjective in a rival. The present common Warm predicate is an exploratory reuse choice, not confirmed morphology.
remaining_obligations: All non-west source duties including east/north attachment alternatives and source gaps are still owed.
All assigned forms outside the 36-group first argument retain these exact values but no whole parses or reference availability are certified.
IT/RF literal alternate rows remain unparsed fixed consequences; uncertain marked forms are not aliases.
Whole-page order and any extra content terminals remain prospective paid choices under the frozen interfaces.
No confirmed lexical bindings, manuscript identification, transferred thermal law or medical advice.
